publisher.chooseGathering.description: Label for the authorized gathering selection field.

publisher.connect.description: Button to start connecting a Place & Plenty account; signup is offered on the website.

publisher.connectRequired.description: Error when the publisher has no account token.

publisher.connectionCanceled.defaultMessage: Connection canceled. You can try again.
publisher.connectionCanceled.description: Notice after the host cancels OAuth authorization.

publisher.connectionInterrupted.defaultMessage: Connection interrupted. Check your gathering before retrying.
publisher.connectionInterrupted.description: Network error; the server may have saved artwork before the response was lost. No automatic retry occurs.

publisher.connectionUnavailable.defaultMessage: Connection unavailable. Try again from Canva.
publisher.connectionUnavailable.description: Error when account authorization cannot be completed.

publisher.emptyExport.description: Publishing error when the exported design has no readable body.

publisher.exportFailed.description: Publishing error when the exported design cannot be downloaded.

publisher.exportTooLarge.description: Publishing error when exported artwork exceeds the upload limit.

publisher.headline.defaultMessage: Design in Canva. Gather with Place & Plenty.
publisher.headline.description: Heading introducing the invitation publisher. Place & Plenty is the product name.

publisher.intro.defaultMessage: Less scrambling. More gathering. Coordinate guests, menus, shopping, and who’s bringing what.
publisher.intro.description: Description of the home-hosting platform in publisher settings.

publisher.invalidExport.description: Publishing error when the Canva export URL is not HTTPS.

publisher.invalidSettings.defaultMessage: Select a gathering and opt in to invitation artwork
publisher.invalidSettings.description: Publishing error when required settings are missing.

publisher.manageGathering.description: Button that opens the external Place & Plenty gathering workflow.

publisher.notNow.description: Button to open external planning without publishing invitation artwork.

publisher.onePng.description: Publishing error when multiple images or the wrong file type are supplied.

publisher.optIn.defaultMessage: Yes, use this design as my digital invitation
publisher.optIn.description: Unchecked consent checkbox that enables invitation artwork publishing.

publisher.planNotice.defaultMessage: Single-day and multi-day planning use your existing Place & Plenty account and plan. After creating a gathering, return here and refresh.
publisher.planNotice.description: Settings explanation; importing artwork does not change subscription access.

publisher.previewAlt.description: Accessible alternative text for the Canva invitation preview image.

publisher.previewFailed.defaultMessage: Preview unavailable. Return to your design and try again.
publisher.previewFailed.description: Preview error when Canva cannot prepare the selected image.

publisher.previewPreparing.description: Status while Canva prepares the preview image.

publisher.previewReplace.defaultMessage: Publishing replaces the selected gathering’s invitation artwork.
publisher.previewReplace.description: Preview warning about replacing the current artwork.

publisher.previewSelect.defaultMessage: Select a gathering and choose to use your design.
publisher.previewSelect.description: Preview prompt shown until a gathering and invitation consent are selected.

publisher.previewTitle.description: Heading above the exported Canva invitation preview.

publisher.publishFailed.description: Fallback publishing error for unexpected failures.

publisher.reconnect.description: Button to authorize a Place & Plenty account again.

publisher.reconnectRequired.description: Error when the backend rejects an expired or invalid account token.

publisher.refreshGatherings.description: Button to reload gatherings after creating or editing one in the external platform.

publisher.replaceNotice.defaultMessage: Review the preview, then choose Publish to save the artwork. Your existing invitation will be replaced.
publisher.replaceNotice.description: Warning before replacing the gathering invitation artwork.

publisher.requestFailed.defaultMessage: The request could not be completed. Check your gathering and try again.
publisher.requestFailed.description: Error after a rejected gathering list or artwork request.

publisher.saveUnconfirmed.description: Publishing error when the backend did not confirm the expected gathering save.

publisher.selectGathering.description: Placeholder before the host selects an authorized gathering.

publisher.slot.artwork.description: Publishing media slot label; a single PNG image.
